sentences.text: Inland rules also say a vessel that reaches agreement on a passing by radiotelephone is not obliged to sound the whistle signals, though she may.
If agreement isn’t reached, whistle signals shall be exchanged in a timely manner, and they prevail.
Bridge-to-bridge calls are usually on VHF channel thirteen.
Under International rules there is no such exemption, so the whistle signals of Rule thirty-four are still required when you maneuver, whatever has been said on the radio.
And under either set of rules, if you are in doubt about the other vessel’s intentions, the danger signal is always available.
